description: Authoritative inventory of every AI/LLM surface in the Hawkeye Sterling suite. Layer 1 (AI Discovery & Inventory) of the 6 Layers of Agentic AI Governance. The deterministic RA scoring engine (index.html) is intentionally NOT an AI asset and is excluded by design.
review_cadence: Quarterly, and on any change to model id, provider, prompt charter, or data flow.

assets.name: MLRO Advisor
assets.autonomy: Responds on explicit user request only; takes no actions and writes no records.
assets.provider: Anthropic (API, server-held ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; key never reaches the browser)
assets.risk_tier_rationale: Decision-support only; never auto-decides, files, or freezes. Outputs are advisory and gated behind MLRO review. Failure mode is a misleading suggestion, mitigated by human sign-off and the SOUL_CHARTER guardrails.
assets.eu_ai_act_class: Limited risk (transparency obligations). Not a high-risk system: it does not make or automate the compliance decision; the human MLRO does.
outputs: Audit line (timestamp, model, mode, elapsed, hash, disclaimer)
controls: Input PII guard (Emirates ID / passport / IBAN): piiFlagged + client warning
In-app AI Acceptable-Use Policy acknowledgment gate (hsra.aup.ack.v1)
Audit line: 'decision support, not a decision. MLRO review required.'
CORS origin allow-list; key held server-side
assets.human_oversight: Human-in-the-loop. Every output is advisory; the MLRO makes and records the decision.
assets.data_retention: Transient. Anthropic API usage (no training on inputs); no server-side persistence in the function. See docs/governance/data-retention.md.

assets.name: Regulatory-Watch AI Draft
assets.autonomy: Runs only inside the Regulatory Watch workflow when a content change is detected AND ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set. Produces a draft proposal; never auto-publishes.
assets.risk_tier_rationale: Optional, off by default, output is a reviewed draft committed for human ratification. No customer data; reads public regulatory sources only.
assets.eu_ai_act_class: Minimal risk. Internal drafting aid; output is reviewed before any use.
outputs: Draft update proposal (markdown) for human review
controls: Detection is automatic; wording change stays a reviewed decision (no auto-publish)
Runs only if ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set (steps in .github/workflows/regulatory-watch.yml)
All output lands in a commit/PR for human review
assets.human_oversight: Human-on-the-loop. Reviewer ratifies or discards every draft.
assets.data_retention: Draft committed to git (docs/research/auto) with full history. No customer data.

shadow_ai_note: No other AI surfaces exist in the suite. The RA scoring engine (index.html), the operations console (console.html), and all watcher scripts (fatf-watchdog, sanctions-watch/screen, regulatory-watch detection, daily-brief, expiry notifier) are deterministic and rules-based, not AI. Any new AI surface MUST be added to this register before deployment.
